app.name: Vertrix
app.long_description: The original DOS Vertrix, recompiled from VERTRIX.EXE. Needs the whole original release (VERTRIX.EXE, BIN1.BIN, BIN2.BIN and the rest) in sd:/apps/vertrix1/. D-pad or stick moves, B or Up permutes, A or 2 is Enter, 1 or Minus is Escape, Plus pauses; a second Wii Remote is player 1 in a two-player game. A USB keyboard also works. HOME exits.
